description: Deptartment of Fiscal Policy - Order to declare the List of excisable articles which are exempt from the payment of Excise (Special Provisions) Duty with effect from 21.11.2015
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - an order issued under the Excise (Special Provisions) Act, No. 13 of 1989, which exempts certain excisable articles from duty payment.
